params.message:
Trends that belong together, and trends that pull against each other

trend_links holds judged links between trends: reinforces or pulls, with one
sentence saying what the two show together. linksOf reads them from either side,
only to trends the reader can open, and follows a folded trend to the one that took
it over. The showcase projection carries each trend's links to the site;
bin/assign-links.mjs writes a reviewed list.
